authorized_scope: General renderer priority change only. No query, acquisition, admission, source caps, owner budgets, providers or state changes.
seam: render_project_brief on admitted DTOs; native toy DTO comes from existing Store support.
reason: V3 frees bytes but protects multiple additional native groups before whole user originals. Additional proof can displace a complete user constraint that fits with the first proof.

plan_interface.input: The existing admitted brief records and original-role pools, owner budget, actual opening/coverage/relation/closing XML costs.
plan_interface.state: Cached serialized nodes, remaining owner characters, current neutral-source spend/count, emitted canonical group identities, emitted direct-source registry, deferred association candidates and exact omission counts.
plan_interface.operation: Offer a complete serialized group in stage order. Price and emit the exact same cached string. Reject the whole group if it exceeds owner or existing neutral limits after reserved omission-marker costs.
plan_interface.output: The admitted original/execution/report nodes, quote-only registry references, deferred associations, and explicit omission counts. No candidate read or source text mutation.

stages: Protect the first complete native execution and first whole assistant report, in the existing requested source order. Their actual serialized cost is the reservation. An unfit first group is disclosed and does not block later fitting groups.

Admit whole already-guarded user originals using the existing newest/material/neutral source ordering. For the same source/body/role, a full admitted custody original takes the turn before a contained selected partial. Fullness comes only from the admitted DTO, never from a source read.
Admit remaining complete canonical native groups and whole reports in existing source_order. Additional native groups cannot pre-reserve the bytes needed by stage-two complete user originals.

Try complementary tool body excerpts after canonical proof. A body interval exactly mirrored by a shown canonical execution output stays a distinct body citation candidate. It either gets its own complete direct quote now or a truthful omission; it is never aliased to tool_response.output.

Render canonical field associations after original transport. quote_ref shares exact quotation provenance only. Each association retains its own role, scope, history, custody, meaning, uncertainty and derived text. Omitted associations are counted explicitly.
invariants: Neutral candidates stay at the existing count and 1800/budget-third limits. Existing 600/1200 source limits and native atomicity remain. No transcript mode.
Every citable source owns source_id, source_role, source_field, start/end and a direct quote_excerpt. Tool command/full output/exit/use ID remain one complete native group.
A whole user original does not become current truth or an active requirement. Its custody qualifiers remain explicit. A history association never inherits currentness from a shared quote.

Same text from different events, source roles, or source fields remains separate. Same-source full-versus-partial body coverage can share the full quote only with exact offsets/text/role/tool identity and independent association qualifiers.
Canonical item IDs stay. Different or absent original qualifier keys do not merge metadata. Capture ordering remains distinct from event time.
Reserve final XML roots, separators, references and omission markers with the same serializer strings used for output. No partial XML, field, command or output.

public_tests.result: 11 tests, one expected failure. A fitting 498-character user constraint disappears when two additional admitted native groups are present at budget 2900. The one-native control fits.
controls: Full custody original shown once before a contained selected partial, whose canonical association keeps its own uncertainty and exact-offset quote_ref.
Native body/output mirrors remain separately citable fields, or explicitly omitted if a later bounded stage cannot fit.
Every quote_ref resolves in the source-only namespace; native groups remain atomic and exact-budget bounded.

evidence_limit: This plan does not promise that every admitted source fits. Central all-span losses and disclosed exact-mirror visibility must be reported independently after implementation.
